Stops immediately and deletes all fill files. What was written so far did overwrite that space, but the rest of the free space was not overwritten. To take a break without losing anything, use Pause.

WHAT IT DOES
Fills all free space of the chosen storage with random data, flushes it to the flash with fsync, and deletes it again. Space that used to hold deleted files is overwritten, so recovery tools have nothing left to find. Existing files are not touched.

A "full" storage still has a little space reserved for the system that an app cannot occupy. The app therefore runs an extra step that makes the file system hand out those blocks too and keep already overwritten ones free instead.

WHILE IT RUNS
• The storage is full for a while and other apps may complain about low space. The fill files are deleted automatically at the end.
• Keep the phone charging. At 5% battery without a charger the wipe pauses, and continues by itself when the charger is connected.
• Writing slows down near the end. That is normal.
• Pause keeps everything written so far. Stop deletes the fill files.

IF IT IS INTERRUPTED
• If the system ends the app, or the phone restarts, the wipe continues by itself from what is already written.
• If it does not, open the app and tap Resume. On Android 11+ the app shows why the system ended it.
• At the first start, allow the app to run in the background when the system asks. Some brands need one more setting:
 Xiaomi / HyperOS: App info → Battery saver → No restrictions
 Huawei / Honor: App launch → manage manually, allow background activity
 OPPO / OnePlus / realme: Battery → allow background activity
 vivo / iQOO: Battery → allow high background power consumption
 Samsung: Battery → Unrestricted

LIMITS
• File names, timestamps and the contents of very small files can sit in file-system metadata that filling free space does not reach.
• Spare blocks inside the flash controller (wear levelling, over-provisioning) are out of reach of every app.
• Storage encryption plus a factory reset covers both: to clear a whole phone, reset it first and run this app afterwards.
• The app has no internet permission and collects nothing.
